name: Monte Carlo ray tracer 1D and 3D surface flux dataset
model_or_instrument: GPU-enabled Monte Carlo ray tracer (Veerman et al. 2022 / rte-rrtmgp-cpp)
size_as_stated: 9,348 paired 1D and 3D estimates of surface flux across 228 unique cloud scenes
resolution: 128 samples per top-of-domain pixel; solar zenith angles 0 to 80 deg in 10 deg increments; azimuth angles spaced by 72 deg
